main_text.p: tubicen; singulæ enim cohortes equitum singulos habent tubicines.
Et tantum de officiariis in cohorte equitum: restant officiarii in cohorte peditum, qui etiam sunt vel superiores vel inferiores.
Superiores sunt vel cum magistratu, vel sine magistratu.

Superiores cum magistratu hi ordine sunt, 1, Tribunus peditum, qui totam cohortem gubernat; 2, Tribuni vicarius, qui absente Tribuno cohorti præest; 3, Signifer, cuius officium in quàlibet cohorte magnum est & singulare. Vexillum enim ipsi tanquam sponsa in perpetuam & individuam societatem coniungitur; quæ societas non nisi morte illius, & belli exitu finitur: quin & ius habet in eos, qui custodiendo vexillo per iuramentum sunt obligati. 4, sequitur ordinum structor, qui vel est superior vel inferior.
Superior ordinum structor 1, observat vitam & delicta militum in ista cohorte; deinde etiam aciem & ordinem instruit & adornat; der oberster Feldwebel.

Inferiores ordinum structores plerunque ex veteranis militibus eliguntur, & hoc officium habent, ut in expeditione militem intra factos ordines cōtineāt, & pulueree nitratū inter sclopetarios distribuant, ut & commeatū ab annona stru-

page.notes: The right page is almost entirely cut off by the binding; only word fragments of its column survive, such as "stru", "desi", "tu", "rurg", and were left out. "puluerē" and "cōtineāt" carry tilde/macron abbreviations as printed. The word before "ordines" in "intra factos ordines" is doubtful. The first line of the page is partly obscured by the stain and reads "tubicen; singulæ enim cohortes equitum singulos" with its first word partly lost.
